A food item which restores {{Energy|+|35}} when consumed.  Since all the items which can be used to craft {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} lack quality levels it can not be improved by using higher quality ingredients. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]].

Cannot be sold.

A single Berry Pie is required for a [[Smiler]] side quest.
